title: 2.6 Normal Microbiota
description: The beneficial microbial communities of the body and how they protect health. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? The community of microbes that normally lives on and in the body
Which term matches this description? A relationship where one organism benefits and the other is unharmed
Which term matches this description? A relationship in which both organisms gain benefits
Which term matches this description? A close and long-term interaction between different species
Which term matches this description? The microorganisms that normally live on the skin surface
Which term matches this description? The microorganisms that inhabit the digestive tract
Which term matches this description? The community of microbes that lives in the mouth
Which term matches this description? The microbial community that colonises the vagina
Which term matches this description? A live microbe that provides a health benefit when consumed
Which term matches this description? A substance that feeds beneficial microbes in the gut
Which term matches this description? A microorganism that causes disease in its host
Which term matches this description? A microbe that causes disease when host defences are weak
Which term matches this description? Beneficial microbes preventing pathogens from establishing
Which term matches this description? The ability of normal flora to resist invading pathogens
Which term matches this description? A harmful imbalance in the normal microbial community
Which term matches this description? A body location that normally contains no microorganisms
Which term matches this description? A community of microbes attached to a surface in a sticky matrix
Which term matches this description? Food transformed by the action of beneficial microbes
Which term matches this description? Normal microbes that help train the host immune system
Which term matches this description? Gut microbes that synthesise vitamins used by the host
